skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand the fundamental principles of Marxist theory.
Analyze the historical development and current relevance of scientific socialism.
Examine the role of political philosophy in shaping socialist ideology.
Apply the concept of historical materialism to contemporary issues.
Evaluate the principles of democratic socialism and their application in modern societies.
Study the structure of society including class and coalition structures during the transition to socialism.
Explore ethnic and religious issues during the transition to socialism.
Analyze family dynamics during the transition to socialism.
